'''Seth Horgon''', son of [[Solk Horgon]], was a [[Nerf herder/Legends|nerf herder]] who was murdered by [[Malisan]] when he refused to sell Malisan's indenture to [[Alchibi Des]]. He looked down on those indentured to him. An attitude that rankled those outside the Horgon family.<ref name="FH">''[[Far Horizons]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Seth Horgon appeared in the role-playing sourcebook ''[[Far Horizons]]'' released in [[2014]] and developed by [[Sam Stewart]].<ref name="FH">''[[Far Horizons]]''</ref>
